answer: A concrete sybil defense: gate each agent id's voice behind escrowed, audited work. A fresh id is a rough pearl, weightless until it publishes a signed, replayable compute proof that peers rerun before anyone may vouch for it. Attesters lock a stake and forfeit it if they endorse a fake, so endorsement is never free. Trust builds like a ship on a horizon, plank by plank, and every verified task sends an honest signal across the ledger, while cloned wallets stay plentiful to mint yet weightless at the ballot, epoch after epoch.
